title: Coordinate Laplacian inner product identity
statement: Let $[?]$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $[?]$, and let a finite nonempty index set label an orthonormal basis of real functions on that set containing the constant-one function. For a positive integer $n$, equip functions on $[?]^n$ with the product probability inner product. If $L_j f$ denotes $f$ minus its average over coordinate $j$, then for all functions $f,g$ on $[?]^n$, $\langle L_j f,L_j g\rangle=\langle f,L_j g\rangle$.
